§3§lDraw costs§r
By default, each Neko-pool draw costs §15§r Neko Coins, and each Shimmering-pool draw costs §11§r Shimmering Neko Coin. Servers can adjust pool costs and pity settings.

§3§lPity rules§r
Default soft pity begins after §130§r consecutive misses of high-rarity rewards. Each additional miss increases the high-rarity entry weight multiplier by §15%§r; §cthis is not a percentage-point increase in drop chance§r. Default hard pity guarantees EPIC or better at §150§r draws in the Neko pool and §130§r in the Shimmering pool. Counters are shared within each team, separately for each pool.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the cost and pity rules, then tick the checkbox. This quest charges no draw fee and does not require a draw.
